messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — metering-emitter latency spike detected in eu-west. Alert: token-emitter-latency > 30s for 5m. (link: https://alerts.redwood/incidents/1742)
sarah: I'm taking this. switching to on-call and looking at the pipeline.
josh: seeing delayed batches from emitter-proxy-eu-1, consumer lag climbing. :eyes:
bill-metering: Ledger shows token counts behind ~18% for last 20m. We're getting automated overage flags for some customers.
anita: Can we pause outgoing overage alerts to avoid noise to customers? Recommend: toggle alerts -> pause via /ops toggle_overage_alerts --scope=eu
sarah: doing the pause now. will confirm when executed.
incident-bot: Command executed: pause_overage_alerts --scope=eu by sarah at 1742024300 :white_check_mark:
josh: running quick reconcile query to estimate backlog:
```
SELECT region, sum(tokens) AS observed FROM usage_emitter
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND region = 'eu-west'
GROUP BY region;
```
josh: query shows observed=2,100,000; expected ~2,500,000 -> ~400k tokens delayed (≈16%).
bill-metering: launching backfill consumer on EU-1 (job id fb-1742). starting now, ETA ~12m at current throughput.
anita: Logs from emitter-proxy-eu-1 show intermittent TLS handshake timeouts to kafka-broker-2 around the same window.
sarah: can infra-team restart kafka-broker-2? @infra-ops please advise.
infra-ops: restarting broker-2 now, will post status.
infra-ops: Broker restart succeeded at 1742024460 :white_check_mark: Recovered TLS handshakes.
josh: backfill consumer fb-1742 shows catch-up rate ~80k tokens/s, tailing lag decreasing.
bill-metering: customer impact summary: transient overage flags were emitted for 3 enterprise customers; paused alerts prevented external notifications, ops-cs has been notified to hold invoices until counts reconcile.
anita: setting incident severity S2 for tracking; creating follow-up ticket (RC: TLS renegotiation mismatch on broker 2).
sarah: handing off to night oncall @morgan in 10m. Morgan, quick brief: emitter latency caused delayed ingestion -> paused overage alerts; backfill running; broker restarted; monitoring looks healthy but we need to confirm full reconciliation to within 1%.
morgan: Ack, I'll take watch. will monitor reconcile progress and coordinate with billing if needed. :thumbsup:
josh: plan: wait for fb-1742 to finish, run reconciliation-report, then unpause alerts and close incident if delta <1% and no new latency for 15m.
incident-bot: Reminder: when backfill completes, run: /ops run_reconciliation_report fb-1742 and attach to ticket.
sarah: thanks all — leaving notes in the incident doc. shifting to monitoring, will handoff to morgan at 1742024842.
morgan: received. I'll post a reconciliation summary in this thread when done.
